messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you doing this week — any blood sugar readings to share, or anything on your mind?
Not great honestly. My insurance denied the test strips again so I've barely been checking. The ones I got were high.

Sorry to hear that — going without strips makes it really hard to manage. Insurance issues are outside what I'm able to help with, but your care team's billing office can usually work appeals on denials. What readings were you able to get?
One was 231 before lunch and one was 208 before bed. I know they're not good.

I've logged both of those — 231 before lunch and 208 before bed — so your care team will see them at their next review. I'm not able to say what they mean clinically, but they're on record. Anything else going on, like symptoms or a change with your medication?
No nothing like that. Just frustrated about the whole insurance mess.
That's a genuinely frustrating situation and I'm sorry I can't do more on that end. I'll set your next check-in for next week — hopefully things look a little different by then. Take care.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
